title: Skipstones and Dragonfly Wings
description: Follow a small river from the grassy bank, through shallows and reeds, to a wide sunlit pond. Expert redesign: dragonfly sluices and swinging reed weights.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage

rooms.name: The grassy riverbank
rooms.lesson: Hop over roots beside the stream. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: Stepping-stone shallows
rooms.lesson: Short hops and longer gaps alternate. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The reed marsh
rooms.lesson: The dry route winds above and below the reeds. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The broad river
rooms.lesson: Board the skiff · step off at the far landing. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The sunny pond
rooms.lesson: Bellflowers carry you over the last lily pools. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
